Case study · Personalized ecommerce

Inkivo.in — made personal, built to convert.

A custom gifting store where shoppers personalize products with photos, logos, and English or Malayalam text, then complete a secure Razorpay checkout and receive timely Resend email updates.

Visit live store
IndustryPersonalized gifts and ecommerce
MarketKerala, India
StatusLive ecommerce website

The challenge

Make every personalized order feel simple.

Custom products involve more decisions than ordinary ecommerce. Customers need to choose an item, upload artwork, enter the right text, understand how it will look, and trust the store with payment and fulfilment.

Our approach

One clear journey from idea to order.

We connected product discovery, customization, preview, checkout, and communication in one responsive flow. The experience supports photos, logos, and text in English or Malayalam while keeping the next action easy to understand.

What we delivered

An ecommerce system built around personalization.

  • Live product customization
  • Photo and logo uploads
  • English and Malayalam text
  • Razorpay payment integration
  • Cart and order workflow
  • Timed Resend email notifications

Customer confidence at every step

The live store lets shoppers turn useful products into personal gifts and complete the journey without leaving the brand experience.

Razorpay handles online payment, while Resend-powered messages keep customers informed at the right points in the order journey. The product pages, policies, contact information, and live previews work together to reduce uncertainty before purchase.

Search-ready foundations

The public store uses descriptive page titles, canonical URLs, crawlable product pages, a sitemap, and structured business data. Continued product content, image optimization, merchant listings, and genuine reviews can grow its visibility further.
